data.narrative:
Aurelius Systems is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Michael LaFramboise and John Marmaduke that has raised $10M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, which span Seed through Series A stages within the same sector.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $10M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a $25M valuation. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE at $1.0B (Seed), Singularity at $400M (Series A), and NODA AI at $125M (Series A). This yields a median peer valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $21M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $212M. The wide spread reflects the substantial variance within the peer set and the limited precision available at Seed stage, where company-specific technology risk and go-to-market execution remain largely unproven. Key uncertainties include the defensibility of Aurelius's technical approach relative to funded competitors and the timing and structure of next-round funding.
